title: The space of n-covectors on ℝ^P is finite-dimensional
statement: For all natural numbers P and n, the real vector space Λ^n(ℝ^P) = Covector (Euclid P) n of continuous alternating n-linear forms (ℝ^P)^n → ℝ, with its pointwise ℝ-module structure, is finite-dimensional over ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), FiniteDimensional ℝ (Covector (Euclid P) n)
